style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: She Gave Everything She Had
images.concept: Two small coins — the entirety of a life's resource offered in one gesture
images.imageAlt: Two very small worn coins resting together on a large stone surface, the coins tiny against the expanse of pale stone
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, two small ancient coins resting side by side on a vast pale stone surface, the coins tiny — almost swallowed by the emptiness of the stone around them — raking side light picking up the worn relief on each coin's surface, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the stone, near-monochrome palette of pale stone and dull metal, Alabaster Books extreme scale contrast, 16:9 with the two coins in the lower center and the vast empty stone surface surrounding them, the smallness of the gift and the immensity of what it represents

images.title: Not One Stone on Another
images.concept: The admired stones — and the prophecy that makes every impressive thing temporary
images.imageAlt: Massive dressed temple stones up close, the surfaces perfectly smooth, mortar joints barely visible, yet a single crack running through
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close view of massive perfectly dressed stone blocks in a temple or monumental wall, the stones enormous and smooth, the joint lines nearly invisible — masterwork of construction — but a single irregular crack running diagonally through two of the largest blocks, the crack new against the ancient smooth surface, raking light revealing both the perfection and the fracture, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette of pale hewn stone, Kinfolk material gravity, 16:9 with the stones filling the frame and the crack the only departure from perfection

images.title: You Will Be My Witnesses
images.concept: Endurance to the end — the promise that not a hair will be lost even in the losing
images.imageAlt: A single green plant growing from a crack between massive stones in a wall, alive in the most unlikely place
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a single green plant growing from a narrow crack between two massive stone blocks in a thick wall, the plant small and improbably alive, the stones surrounding it immense and cold, raking afternoon light picking out the plant against the deep shadow of the crack, the plant's leaves bright against the stone's gray, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the stone surface, muted palette of pale stone and one note of living green, Alabaster Books tenacity, 16:9 with the crack running vertically and the plant centered in the frame, the life that persists in the impossible place

images.title: Jerusalem Surrounded
images.concept: The city encircled — the end that was prophesied arriving in a specific moment of history
images.imageAlt: A distant view of a walled city from beyond, surrounded by an empty plain, the city isolated and the plain featureless
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a wide landscape view with a walled city on a distant hill completely surrounded by empty treeless plain, the city the only vertical feature in an otherwise flat empty landscape, the plain extending to all horizons with no approach route visible, harsh flat light, the city isolated and small against the vast surrounding emptiness, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the sky, muted near-monochrome palette of pale earth and pale sky and dark city silhouette, Kinfolk landscape finality, 16:9 with the surrounded city small in the center and the empty landscape filling all four directions

images.title: They Will See the Son of Man Coming
images.concept: Signs in sun and moon and stars — the cosmos signaling the arrival of liberation
images.imageAlt: A pre-dawn sky with the last stars fading and a thin crescent moon, the horizon just beginning to separate from the dark earth
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a pre-dawn sky with a thin crescent moon low on the horizon and a few remaining stars, the horizon just beginning to separate sky from dark earth in the faintest gray-gold warmth, everything else still in deep blue-gray darkness, the moon and stars the only defined objects, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain especially in the dark sky, muted cold palette of deep blue-gray and silver-white moon and stars with one barely warm note at the horizon, Alabaster Books cosmic scale, 16:9 with the crescent moon low in the frame and the stars scattered above, the sky itself as the sign

images.title: When You See These Things
images.concept: The first leaf on the fig branch — the visible sign that summer is near
images.imageAlt: A bare fig tree branch with one young leaf just unfurling, the rest of the branch still winter-bare, warm spring light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close study of a bare fig tree branch with one single young leaf just beginning to unfurl, the leaf pale and tender against the gray bark, the surrounding branches still entirely bare, warm spring light from the side lighting the new leaf so it glows, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette of gray bark and one pale tender green, Kinfolk close botanical attention, 16:9 with the branch and the single leaf centered and the bare winter branches extending around it, the single sign that reads the season before anyone else can see it

images.title: Watch at All Times
images.concept: The lamp kept burning — the discipline of staying awake when sleep would be easier
images.imageAlt: A small oil lamp burning steadily in the predawn darkness, the flame steady, the surrounding darkness total
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a single small clay oil lamp burning steadily in total darkness, the flame small and consistent, the light it casts barely reaching the surface it rests on, the surrounding darkness absolute, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the darkness, near-monochrome palette with only the single warm amber note of the flame, Alabaster Books vigil, 16:9 with the small lamp in the lower center and the vast darkness filling the rest of the frame, the flame sustained through the night the entire subject
